releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.9 — the full message-actions menu, in chats and groups alike. Long-press a message and the quick reactions now light up the ones you already used, with the smiley button opening the complete 32-emoji Reactions sheet that slides up from the bottom. Delete now asks how you want to remove the message — 'Delete for Everyone' (your own messages, within an hour) leaves the reference tombstone behind, 'Delete for Me' removes it just for you, and Cancel backs out. Reactions you have given are highlighted in violet on the bubbles, and deleted messages can no longer be replied to, copied, forwarded or reacted to.
